reviews.title: Program OK
reviews.review: I like the program, but you need to have it calculate fuel economy even with partial fill ups. Have a button that you can push for partials, other programs I have had had this and had shown the fuel economy calculations.Thank you for the response, that helped I missed it when I was entering the information.

reviews.title: Pay for iCloud?
reviews.review: I loved this App and used it religiously for over a year. I event payed 99 cents for ad free to help support the developer. I recently had to switch iPhones and re-downloaded the app. None of my data from this app crossed over to my new iPhone. Turns out you have to pay $4.99 for iCloud back up. Now why in the world would I pay you to back up my data to apple servers? To whom I pay $2.99 for 200GB of cloud storage. The developer does not need to charge for this feature because apple offer

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.review: This program is superb. The input system is easy and intuitive, and the ability to easily track and graph your fuel economy over time is very valuable. Thank you to the developer for his dedication to the program.

reviews.title: Excellent App to record fuel consumption
reviews.review: Was in search of good app and found it. Really helpful to keep track of fuel consumption for multiple vehicles. Would have been great if maintenance records can be also added

reviews.title: Great App!
reviews.review: Great program - not an issue & easy to use. I track all my vehicles and do not have to guess or remember data. So it right at the pump when I am done.
